collection.description: A child is upset when a favorite wooden toy cracks.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) is upset when a favorite wooden toy cracks.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a builder, shows how repeated bending weakened the wood.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that dropping a toy can cause a hidden crack.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The repair fails, but (child) saves a piece as a keepsake.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The broken pieces become harmless counting tokens.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) decides to retire the toy and make up a story about it.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) needs more time before deciding what to do.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: (child) practices careful handwork while fixing the toy.
